effect_360reorientsphere_desc: Reorients a 360º photo or video in equirectangular format.This effect interprets the layer as an equirectangular photo or video, projects it onto a sphere, rotates the sphere, and then projects the sphere back into equirectangular format. The result is as if the original camera that recorded the 360º image or video had been positioned at a different angle.
effect_360viewer_desc: Projects a 360º photo or video onto a flat surface, as if viewed from within the 360º sphere.
effect_advanced_chroma_key_desc: Keys out pixels based on how closely they match or don\'t match a group of colors, making the keyed out parts of the layer transparent. This is similar to the Chroma Key effect but offers more precise control and more color options. Useful for greenscreening or bluescreening.
effect_bend_desc: Bends the layer along a circular arc.
effect_blink_desc: Automatically adjusts the opacity of the layer, alternating between its normal value and zero over time.
effect_blocknoise_desc: Multiplies randomly generated rectangular blocks of noise with the existing colors of opaque parts of the layer.
effect_box_desc: Renders a faux-3D box using the layer as a surface texture.
effect_boxblur3_tip: For a smoother blur, try Gaussian Blur.
effect_boxblur_desc: Blurs the layer by averaging the colors of nearby pixels in a surrounding rectangular area (hence box blur).
effect_boxblur_tip: More iterations give better quality, but slower preview performance. We recommend 2 iterations.
effect_brightnessContrast_desc: Adjusts the brightness or contrast of the layer.
effect_bumpmap_desc: Uses a height map to model bumps or perturbations in the surface of the layer, then applies simulated lighting and shading.
effect_channelmap_desc: Remaps the red, green, blue, and alpha channels in the layer.
effect_channelmaphsv_desc: Remaps the hue, saturation, value, and alpha channels in the layer.
effect_channelshift_desc: Splits the red, green and blue channels of the layer, keeping one fixed in position and shifting the other two channels in opposite directions.
effect_checker_desc: Renders a checkerboard pattern in the opaque parts of the layer.
effect_checkerdissolve_desc: Randomly removes grid-aligned rectangular pieces from the layer by making them transparent. Keyframe animation can be applied to remove progressively more and more rectangles over time.
effect_chromakey_desc: Keys out all pixels similar to a particular color, making those parts of the layer transparent. Useful for greenscreening or bluescreening.
effect_chromatic_zoomblur_desc: Applies a radial blur to the layer resulting in a zoom-in and zoom-out effect, dynamically adjusting the strength of the blur for each color channel.
effect_circularripple_desc: Distorts the layer in a pattern concentric circles around a center point, similar to the ripples caused by a pebble dropped in water.
effect_clouds_desc: Renders a procedurally generated cloud pattern in the opaque parts of the layer.
effect_color_balance_desc: Makes targeted adjustments to the Red, Green, and Blue channels based on shadows, midtones, and highlights.
effect_colorize_desc: Changes the color of the layer, keeping the original luminance.
effect_colortemperature_desc: Corrects a photo or video so it appears as if illuminated by a light source with a different color temperature. Useful for changing the mood of a scene or correcting for the wrong illumination or white balance.
effect_colortune_desc: Smoothly tune the color of dark and light parts of a photo or video segmented by lift, gamma, and gain. Use this to achieve various color looks, to change the mood of the video, or to match the color of different takes.
effect_contour_strips_desc: Renders strips of thin paper-like material, layered front to back, using the layer luminance or opacity as a height map for each strip.
effect_contourgrad_desc: Renders a gradient around the contours of the opaque parts of the layer.
effect_contourlines_desc: Draws one or more lines around the contours of the opaque parts of the layer.
effect_copybg_desc: Copies the background into the layer, effectively turning the layer into an adjustment layer. Effects applied to the layer after this will apply to the background pixels covered by the opaque parts of the layer.
effect_copybg_tip: This effect copies the pixels behind this layer into the current layer. Use this together with other effects to apply them to the background. For example, to use Box Blur after applying Copy Background to blur the background.
effect_counter_desc: Replaces existing numbers in a text layer with the same number added to or multiplied with a fixed value. Useful for creating animations that count up or down.
effect_cube_desc: Renders a faux-3D cube using the layer as a surface texture.
effect_curl_desc: Deforms the layer by curling it into a circular shape from one end.
effect_cylinder_desc: Renders a faux-3D cylinder using the layer as a surface texture.
effect_dark_glow_desc: Creates dark blooms around darker areas within a photo or video layer based on a luminance threshold.
effect_dblur_desc: Blurs the layer by averaging nearby pixel colors along a specified angle, similar to the blur caused by motion in a fixed direction.
effect_displacemap_desc: Displaces pixels in the background based on the color of pixels in the layer.
effect_displacemaprad_desc: Angularly displaces pixels in the background based on the color of pixels in the layer.
effect_dissolve_desc: Randomly removes pixels in the layer. This effect can be animated to create a pixel dissolve transition.
effect_dots_desc: Draws a pattern of random dots in the opaque parts of the layer. Each dot is placed randomly, but the randomness is controlled so that the overall distribution of dots when taken together is approximately uniform.
effect_drawingprogress_desc: Clips the beginning and end of the vector outline of the layer so that the outline is only partially drawn.
effect_echo_keyframes_desc: Creates one or more copies or echoes of the layer as it appeared or will appear at different points in time, based only on keyframe animation applied to the layer.
effect_edge_glow_desc: Detects edges in a photo or video and creates a glow around them.
effect_electric_edges_desc: Creates a glowing energy-like outline and optional contour lines around the opaque parts of the layer, which can be animated to look like arcs of electricity.
effect_ellipsoid_desc: Renders a faux-3D ellipsoid using the layer as a surface texture.
effect_energy_beam_desc: Renders a beam of energy between two points within the layer.
effect_exposure_desc: Adjusts the exposure, gamma curve, and luminance offset of photo and video layers.
effect_fade_desc: Automatically animates the layer opacity to fade the layer in at its beginning, and out again at its end.
effect_fastboxblur_tip: More iterations give better quality, but slower preview performance. We recommend 3 iterations.
effect_feather_desc: Softens the edges of the opaque part of the layer by blurring the alpha channel.
effect_fill_behind_desc: Fills the area behind the layer with a modified copy of the layer, with optional adjustments such as blur, saturation, tint, and brightness, providing a convenient way to quickly adapt a photo or video for use in a project with a different aspect ratio or orientation.
effect_findedges_desc: Finds edges in a photo or video layer by detecting sharp changes in luminance between nearby pixels.
effect_flicker_desc: Randomly flickers the layer by automatically adjusting the opacity over time.
effect_flip2_desc: Flips the layer in 3D along a specified axis.
effect_fourcolorgradient_desc: Overlays the opaque parts of the layer with a gradient made between four individually positioned colors.
effect_fractwarp_desc: Distorts the layer using a procedurally generated fractal pattern. Useful for simulating distortions caused by real-world phenomena such as fire, water, and heat.
effect_gaussianblur_desc: Applies a fast, smooth blur to the layer using a gaussian function, reducing noise and details in the layer.
effect_glass_desc: Renders the layer as if the opaque parts were made of beveled glass, refracting the background and overlaying specular highlights.
effect_glow_desc: Draws a glow around the outside of the opaque parts of the layer.
effect_glowinner_desc: Draws a glow along the inside edges of the opaque parts the layer.
effect_glowscan_desc: Renders a blur combined with a smooth glow within a region of the layer defined by a luminance band.
effect_gradientmap_desc: Maps colors in the layer onto a gradient based on their lightness.
effect_gradientoverlay_desc: Overlays the opaque parts of the layer with a gradient.
effect_grid_desc: Overlays the opaque parts of the layer with grid lines.
effect_grunge_desc: Builds up multiple layers of simulated grunge, grime, spots, specks, stains and blemishes within the center and inner edges of the layer based on preset textures or grains, creating an aged, worn, or textured look to the layer.
effect_halftonedots_desc: Replaces continuous tones in the layer with a pattern of monochrome dots of varying sizes, similar to the process used in newspaper or comic book printing.
effect_halftonedotscmyk_desc: Replaces continuous tones in the layer with a pattern of dots of varying sizes for each CMYK color channel, similar to the process used in magazine or comic book printing.
effect_halftonelines_desc: Replaces continuous tones in the layer with a pattern of monochrome lines of varying thickness, a variation of the process used in newspaper or comic book printing.
effect_heart_desc: Renders a faux-3D heart using the layer as a surface texture.
effect_hexarray_desc: Covers opaque parts of the layer in an array of hexagons.
effect_hexprism_desc: Renders a faux-3D hexagonal prism using the layer as a surface texture.
effect_hexrotate_desc: Divides the layer into a grid of hexagonal tiles and rotates the pixels in each tile independently.
effect_hexshift_desc: Divides the layer into a grid of hexagonal tiles and shifts the contents of each tile in a random direction.
effect_hextile_desc: Repeats the layer in a pattern of hexagonal tiles, filling the screen.
effect_highlightShadow_desc: Independently adjusts the intensity of the lightest and darkest parts of the layer.
effect_hollow_box_desc: Renders a faux-3D hollow box, using the layer as a surface texture, with sides that can be turned on or off, punched out with preset shapes, or offset outward.
effect_hotcolor_desc: Remaps a grayscale image (or luminance values of a color image) into an intense color ramp based on two selected hues.
effect_hueshift_desc: Rotates the color hues in the layer.
effect_innerblur_desc: Blurs the opaque parts of the layer without blurring the opacity.
effect_invert_desc: Inverts the layer\'s red, green, or blue channels independently.
effect_irrid_desc: Renders a flowing iridescent pattern in opaque parts of the layer.
effect_jitter_desc: Automatically jumps the layer randomly back and forth over time, along a selected angle.
effect_kaleidoscope_desc: Creates symmetric radial reflections of the layer.
effect_key_spill_cleaner_desc: Cleans up greenscreen or bluescreen spill near the edges of a layer, such as the green fringe left over after applying a matte effect such a Chroma Key, by isolating a feathered region around the inside of the edges of the layer and propagating interior hue and saturation outward into the isolated region while maintaining the original luminance.
effect_lensblur_desc: Applies an angular blur to the layer, excluding the central area.
effect_lensflare_desc: Renders a lens flare in the layer.
effect_light_glow_desc: Creates a soft glow and optional halo around the lighter areas within a photo or video layer based on a luminance threshold.
effect_lightning_desc: Renders fractal arcs of lightning between two points in the layer.
effect_linearstreaks_desc: Creates line-shaped streaks by sliding the layer at an angle and blending together overlapping pixels.
effect_longshadow_desc: Renders long parallel shadows extending from opaque parts of the layer.
effect_luma_stamper_desc: Extracts a mask from the layer based on the brightness of pixels in the layer, optionally clipping out noise in the extreme light and dark areas of the layer, then uses the mask to stamp a solid color into the project.
effect_lumakey_desc: Keys out all pixels lighter than or darker than a given threshold, making those parts of the layer transparent.
effect_magnify_background_desc: Makes the layer transparent and magnifies the area behind the layer, as if the layer were a magnifying glass.
effect_maskblur_desc: Blurs the background behind the layer, with the blur strength based on the layer luminance.
effect_mattechoke_desc: Expands the transparent parts of the layer, shrinking the opaque parts.
effect_mattefringe_desc: Isolates a narrow feathered strip around the interior edge of the layer and replaces the hue and saturation in that strip with the hue and saturation behind the layer, keeping the original luminance. Use this after applying a matte or key effect to reduce stray colors in the edge of the matte.
effect_mblur_desc: Simulates motion blur by blurring the layer based on position, rotation, and scale keyframe animation from the layer\'s Move & Transform settings, as well as motion from certain other effects that are compatible with motion blur.
effect_mblur_tip: To use: Animate the layer using Move & Transform (blur will be applied automatically).
effect_mirror_desc: Overlays the layer with a copy of itself mirrored along either the horizontal or vertical axis, with optional alpha and blending mode control.
effect_mosaic_desc: Divides the layer into array of squares and averages the color of each square, resulting in a pixelated look.
effect_movealongpath_desc: Positions the layer at a point partway way along the outline path of the layer immediately beneath.
effect_noise_desc: Blends random noise with the opaque parts of the layer.
effect_octahedron_desc: Renders a faux-3D regular octahedron using the layer as a surface texture.
effect_offset_desc: Offsets the layer content, wrapping at the edges of the bounding box of the layer.
effect_omino_diffusion_desc: Renders a photo or video layer with a limited palette using error diffusion, but damping or exaggerating the quantization errors to create intentional distortions. Individual images become unrecognizable, but action can be seen in the moving aggregate. This effect is based on the Omino Suite, with special thanks to David Van Brink.
effect_omino_glass_desc: Renders the layer as though it were made of glass, with refraction and a glossy contour, and chromatic aberration based on segmentation of the visible spectrum into seven regions. The layer luminance may optionally be used as a height map. This effect is based on the Omino Suite, with special thanks to David Van Brink.
effect_oscillate_desc: Moves the layer back and forth repeatedly.
effect_page_curl_desc: Curls a corner of the layer upwards as if the layer were made of paper or thin plastic.
effect_palettemap_desc: Maps pixel colors in the layer to the closest matching color in a palette.
effect_parenthelper_desc: Adjusts how the layer\'s scale and rotation react to changes in the parent\'s scale and rotation.
effect_parenthelper_tip: To use: Parent this layer to another using Layer Parenting (this effect shoud be applied to a child layer)
effect_pinchbulge_desc: Distorts the layer by pinching it towards the center or expanding it outward.
effect_pinchbulgeinside_desc: Distorts the layer by pinching it towards the center or expanding it outwards, without affecting the edges or opacity of the layer.
effect_pixelate_desc: Decreases the layer resolution so that individual pixels become visible, sampling at the centers of the pixels, and drawing each pixel with an optional vignette.
effect_plus_desc: Renders a faux-3D three-axis cross using the layer as a surface texture.
effect_polar_desc: Warps the layer by mapping from cartesian coordinates to polar coordinates.
effect_posterize_desc: Decreases the number of step in the layer\'s color channels.
effect_pulsate_desc: Automatically grows and shrinks the layer repeatedly over time, based on a sine wave or triangular wave.
effect_pulseopacity_desc: Automatically pulses the layer opacity over time, based on a sine wave or triangular wave.
effect_pyramid_desc: Renders a faux-3D regular pyramid with a square base, using the layer as a surface texture.
effect_radialrays_desc: Overlays multiple solid-color radial rays in the opaque parts of the layer.
effect_radialshadow_desc: Renders long shadows radiating away from a point, based on the opaque parts of the layer.
effect_radialwipe_desc: Masks out a region of the layer bounded by two radial lines.
effect_raster_extrude_desc: Renders a faux-3D raster extrusion of the layer based on the opaque and transparent pixels within the layer, using the opaque parts of the layer as a surface texture for the front and back of the extrusion.
effect_raster_transform_desc: Scales, rotates, or offsets the layer, much like Move & Transform, but after rasterization and after applying any preceding effects on the layer, allowing the output of effects to be transformed.
effect_raymarch_iter_tip: Increase precision for better edge quality; decrease for faster preview performance. For best results, an precision between 30 and 60 is recommended.
effect_raymarch_tip: Use more iterations for better edge quality; use less iterations for faster preview performance. For best results, an iteration count between 30 and 60 is recommended.
effect_rays_desc: Renders light rays from bright parts of the layer, based on the threshold setting.
effect_repeat_desc: Dynamically generates multiple copies of the layer.
effect_repeatgrid_desc: Dynamically generates multiple copies of the layer, arranged in a grid.
effect_repeatline_desc: Dynamically generates multiple copies of the layer, arranged along a line.
effect_repeatpath_desc: Dynamically generates multiple copies of the layer along the outline path of the layer immediately beneath.
effect_repeatradial_desc: Dynamically generates multiple copies of the layer, arranged in a circular pattern.
effect_repeatscatter_desc: Dynamically generates multiple copies of the layer, scattered randomly around the original layer location.
effect_replacecolor_desc: Replaces one color in the layer with another.
effect_rgb_gamma_desc: Adjusts the gamma curve of the red, green, and blue channels independently.
effect_rgb_mixer_desc: Remixes the red, green and blue channels in the layer.
effect_ribbon_desc: Renders a twisted, flowing ribbon of varying width in the opaque parts of the layer.
effect_ridges_desc: Renders a procedurally generated pattern of turbulent ridges in the opaque parts of the layer.
effect_ring_desc: Renders a faux-3D ring with flat faces, using the layer as a surface texture.
effect_roughenedges_desc: Roughens the edges of the opaque parts of the layer.
effect_scaleassist_desc: Applies additional layer scale on top of the scale set in Move & Transform.
effect_scatter_field_desc: Scatters copies of the layer within an infinite 3D field while hiding the original layer, and allows simulated motion within the field in three dimensions through keyframe animation.
effect_shake_desc: Moves the layer randomly over time within specified parameters.
effect_sharpen_desc: Enhances details in the layer by increasing the contrast wherever there are abrupt differences in the luminance of nearby pixels in the layer.
effect_simplestars_desc: Renders a simple parallax starfield pattern, with a depth component, in the opaque parts of the layer.
effect_simplexdisplace_desc: Automatically moves the layer smoothly but randomly over time
effect_smooth_edges_desc: Smooths the edges of the opaque parts of a layer without affecting the pixel colors within the layer.
effect_smoothbevel_desc: Draws a smooth curved bevel inside the edges of the opaque parts of the layer.
effect_soft_glow_desc: Creates a soft Gaussian-based glow within a photo or video layer, or around the outside edge of any layer.
effect_solidcolor_desc: Fills the opaque parts of the layer with a solid color.
effect_solidmatte_desc: Composites the layer on a solid color matte, filling transparent parts of the layer with a solid background color.
effect_spectralmap_desc: Maps each color in the layer into a custom spectrum of colors based on the brightness of the original color.
effect_spherize_desc: Renders a faux-3D sphere, interpreting the layer as an equirectangular projection and using it as a surface texture for the sphere.
effect_spin_desc: Automatically spins the layer at a given speed.
effect_spinblur_desc: Applies an angular blur to the layer, as though it were spinning.
effect_spinstreaks_desc: Creates arc-shaped streaks by spinning the layer around a point and blending together overlapping pixels.
effect_spotcolor_desc: Keeps one color while decreasing the saturation of other colors in the layer.
effect_squeeze_desc: Distorts the layer by squeezing it along one axis while expanding it along the other axis.
effect_star_desc: Renders an individual star in the current layer.
effect_star_polyhedron_desc: Renders a faux-3D star polyhedron using the layer as a surface texture.
effect_starfield_desc: Renders a complex parallax starfield that can be animated in two dimensions.
effect_starprism_desc: Renders a faux-3D star prism using the layer as a surface texture.
effect_streak_strips_desc: Divides the layer into strips of equal size, then stretches the middle row of pixels in each one to fill the entire strip, resulting in streaks of color.
effect_stretch_desc: Stretches the layer in an arbitrary direction.
effect_stretchsegment_desc: Slices the layer along an angle and then moves the pieces apart, stretching the pixels between them.
effect_stripes_desc: Renders a pattern of stripes in the opaque parts of the layer.
effect_stroketaper_desc: Tapers the strokes of a freehand drawing layer.
effect_swing_desc: Automatically rotates the layer back and forth over time.
effect_swirl_desc: Warps the layer by rotating it different amounts based on the distance from a center-point, resulting in a vortex or whirlpool-like distortion.
effect_textprogress_desc: Partially displays a text layer, character by character.
effect_textrandomize_desc: Randomly changes individual characters in a text layer.
effect_textspacing_desc: Adjusts the spacing between individual letters or between lines of text in a text layer.
effect_texttransform_desc: Transforms individual letters, words, lines, or pieces of letters within a specified range of a text layer.
effect_threshold_desc: Converts the layer to black and white with a hard cutoff at the specified luminance threshold.
effect_tilerotate_desc: Divides the layer into a grid of tiles and rotates the pixels in each tile independently.
effect_tiles_desc: Repeats the layer in a tile pattern, filling the screen.
effect_tileshift_desc: Divides the layer into a grid of tiles and shifts the contents of each tile in a random direction.
effect_timecode_desc: Replaces the text in the layer with a running timecode.
effect_timequant_desc: Causes time to pass in steps, but just for this layer.
effect_tip_echokf: To use: Animate the layer using keyframe animation with other effects or properties (echoes will be created based on keyframe animation).
effect_torus_desc: Renders a faux-3D torus using the layer as a surface texture.
effect_tunnel_desc: Renders a round faux-3D tunnel using the layer as the interior surface texture.
effect_turbulence_desc: Renders smooth patterns of procedurally-generated fractal noise in the opaque parts of the layer, useful for simulating real-world phenomena like clouds, or for use as a luminance map.
effect_turbulentdisplace_desc: Distorts the layer along selected coordinate axes using a random pattern of smooth fractal noise. Distortion may be along one or more axis in either cartesian or polar coordinate space. Useful for simulating distortions caused by real-world phenomena such as fire, water, and heat, or for modeling real-world objects that are naturally irregular such as mountains.
effect_unsharp_mask_desc: Enhances the perceptual sharpness or acutance of a photo or video by increasing local contrast near edges, while avoiding changes to areas that were originally smooth.
effect_vibranceSaturation_desc: Adjusts the saturation or purity of colors in the layer.
effect_vibranceSaturation_tip: Vibrance is a milder saturation boost that affects only midrange colors without causing over-saturation. It is best used with video or photographic images.
effect_vignette_desc: Darkens the edges of the layer.
effect_voronoi_desc: Renders procedurally-generated pattern of Voronoi cells based on randomly placed points.
effect_warpblur_desc: Warp Blur creates a paintbrush-like streaky distortion of a layer by blurring along gradients of a fractal noise field.
effect_wavewarp_desc: Distorts the layer based on a sine wave.
effect_wipe_desc: Masks out rectangular segments from opposite sides of the layer. Use keyframe animation to create a wipe transition.
effect_zoomblur_desc: Applies a radial blur to the layer, as though zooming in or out.
effect_zoomstreaks_desc: Creates radial streaks by scaling the layer around a point and blending together overlapping pixels.
